applicableDomain: Outpatient Clinical Consultation & Parallel Ancillary Care Coordination
descriptionAndPurpose: Canonical composable parent patient journey coordinating MPI identity verification, arrival/check-in, single encounter creation, triage escalation, configurable billing clearance, departmental consultation queuing, clinician assessment, parallel lab/radiology/pharmacy subworkflows, result inbox review, return-to-queue follow-up, and safe encounter finalization without forcing concurrent departmental tasks into a single linear state machine.
prerequisiteConditions: Authoritative MPI search executed prior to registration; never silently duplicate patient identity.
Single active Encounter opened for the visit and linked across all child subworkflows.
Facility tenant context verified on every command and repository query.
safetyChecks: Clinically unstable triage acuity immediately activates EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypassing prepayment holds.
Allergies, active medications, and prior critical results surfaced prior to signing orders.
Encounter finalization blocked while unacknowledged critical results or required active departmental tasks remain open.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Evaluated via WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi against facility policy configuration.
Supports all 11 PaymentClearanceOutcome states without creating a duplicate ledger.
Financial hold routes patient/order to CASHIER worklist while strictly preserving underlying clinical order.
exceptionRoutes: EMERGENCY_RESUSCITATION_ESCALATION on unstable vital signs or ESI Level 1-2
MPI_DUPLICATE_STEWARDSHIP_QUEUE on ambiguous patient match score
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Non-emergency encounters may be paused or cancelled prior to disposition with mandatory audit reason; financial holds suspend activation without deleting orders and automatically resume upon idempotent ServiceCleared event.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: Every state transition, billing override, queue claim, order route, result acknowledgment, and discharge emits immutable hash-chained @ClinicalAudit records carrying facilityId, patientId, encounterId, actorId, and correlationId.
completionCriteria: All mandatory clinician result reviews acknowledged (zero unacknowledged critical results), all active blocking departmental fulfillment tasks resolved or explicitly deferred to outpatient follow-up, and disposition recorded.
